scope: 20 original hero scenes on 10 paired plates; choreography descriptions are proposed light patterns, not timed animation.

concepts.name: Hopf Halo
concepts.standout: A luminous sphere resolves into hundreds of linked circles, with slow color currents slipping between them.
concepts.scene: A monumental spherical sculpture of many discrete linked circular LED hoops, each tilted on its own axis, a nested orbital center and a clear dark void through the middle. Jade, pearl and restrained amber; a museum courtyard with tiny people and grounded black supports. The overall mass is a sphere but individual linked circles remain readable.
concepts.choreography: Phase-offset chases travel around hoop families, then a dim-to-bright meridian reveals the linked layers.
concepts.constraint: A Hopf-inspired finite circle arrangement; intersecting hoops, maintenance access and supports need actual design.

concepts.name: Gyroid Dream Chamber
concepts.standout: A honeycomb-like continuous maze seems to breathe as light crawls through its saddle-shaped passages.
concepts.scene: A walk-in pavilion made of luminous coral-orange and ice-blue contour lattices tracing a gyroid-inspired triply periodic saddle maze. Continuous undulating passages and porous openings at three depths, no ordinary hexagonal honeycomb. Black structural edges and an open entrance let viewers see the repeated curved cells.
concepts.choreography: Slow opposing waves run through connected corridors, with alternating cool inner paths and warm outer edges.
concepts.constraint: Curved segmented ribs can suggest the surface; exact periodic geometry and sightlines require native meshing.

concepts.name: Quasicrystal Palace
concepts.standout: Fivefold star clusters build a crystalline palace whose patterns never settle into a simple repeating grid.
concepts.scene: An open nocturnal palace assembled from faceted decagonal crowns, pentagonal star joints, rhombic ribs and nonrepeating scales. Champagne gold, sapphire and tiny white junction lights. Distinct porch, branching spires, layered interior and wide black gaps; not a solid glass castle.
concepts.choreography: Illumination migrates between matching star motifs at different scales, creating apparent reorganization.
concepts.constraint: Aperiodic pattern boundaries and module sizes must be chosen before supports and channel groups.

concepts.name: Hyperbolic Coral Pavilion
concepts.standout: Recursive frills unfold like a coral organism, with waves reaching every curled edge.
concepts.scene: A giant magenta-to-peach hyperbolic coral-shaped LED pavilion with dramatically ruffled open rib surfaces and finely subdivided curled hems. An undulating central canopy, several smaller coral fans on the ground, dark supports, midnight indigo background. Distinct negative spaces through the frills, no underwater photographic coral.
concepts.choreography: Light expands from branch roots to curling hems; adjacent frills answer with delayed soft pulses.
concepts.constraint: Artwork suggests increasing curvature; nested ribs and visibility must be simplified into finite modules.

concepts.name: Trefoil Cathedral
concepts.standout: One continuous luminous knot forms a cathedral portal, with crossing strands alternately taking the lead.
concepts.scene: A soaring trefoil-knot light arch with exactly three broad looping lobes, braided parallel contour ribs and clearly separated over-under crossings. Deep cobalt and warm copper with pearl edge dots, a dark processional path through the lower void and small people. Architectural, sculptural and elegant, not a conventional Gothic church.
concepts.choreography: A highlight follows the closed knot while crossing layers trade brightness to clarify depth.
concepts.constraint: Crossings need real separation and reinforcement; the audience must see the over-under ordering.

concepts.name: Enneper Silk Garden
concepts.standout: Twisting saddle petals behave like silk caught in a slow invisible current.
concepts.scene: A delicate garden of three Enneper-inspired open lattice saddle sculptures, broad curling petals folded up and down around central necks. Mint, lilac and warm white on fine bronze contour ribs, pebble-dark bases and small winding paths. Crisp surfaces, visible empty squares and large calm black spaces.
concepts.choreography: Broad gradients drift across each saddle while edge chases climb and descend the folded lobes.
concepts.constraint: Surface self-intersections and physical rib spacing need simplification; light does not physically move the petals.

concepts.name: Penrose Lantern City
concepts.standout: A miniature city of nonrepeating lanterns changes from a pattern into a skyline as its layers awaken.
concepts.scene: A luminous lantern city with thin and thick rhombus faces forming Penrose-inspired stars, stacked into stepped open towers at different heights. Rich vermilion, honey gold and midnight teal. Low tessellated plaza, clear towers and arch gaps, tiny visitors, detailed rhombic frames rather than solid blocks.
concepts.choreography: Fivefold plaza stars light first, then corresponding tower faces rise in overlapping waves.
concepts.constraint: The 3D extension is artistic; an exact planar tiling and modular transition rules need selection.

concepts.name: Lissajous Heart Engine
concepts.standout: Nested oscillating paths form an intricate heart-like engine, with beads of light endlessly trading places.
concepts.scene: A monumental symmetric luminous sculpture of nested closed Lissajous-style looping curves, a heart-like outer silhouette with many crossing lobes and a small glowing orbital core. Electric turquoise, hot pink and clean white, on a charcoal plinth. Exact-looking smooth wire curves, no literal anatomical heart, no gears.
concepts.choreography: Independent packets circulate along curve families with changing phase offsets and a quiet bright core.
concepts.constraint: Closed curves must be sampled and crossing nodes kept electrically and visually distinct.

concepts.name: Voronoi Starfall Canyon
concepts.standout: A canyon of fractured cells draws the eye toward a distant star, then releases cascades toward the viewer.
concepts.scene: Tall open-rib canyon walls made of irregular three-dimensional Voronoi polyhedral cells, amethyst at the entrance fading to arctic blue and silver deep inside. Cells grow smaller toward a bright distant eight-point star; rocky silhouettes are entirely cellular light frames, a clear central walkway.
concepts.choreography: Cell-edge cascades move from the vanishing star toward the foreground, followed by slow breathing across opposite walls.
concepts.constraint: Depth and density are artistic; audience clearance and cell connectivity need a finite build plan.

concepts.name: Cymatic Lotus Observatory
concepts.standout: Concentric petals and star-shaped nodes dissolve into one another like a slowly changing vibration.
concepts.scene: An enormous low lotus-shaped light observatory with nested radial petal rings, raised filigree rosette disks and a small suspended-looking pearl center supported by a dark central stem. Gold, emerald and white. Fine radial spokes, petal voids and a tranquil open court; contour light only.
concepts.choreography: Alternating radial sectors reveal different nodal patterns; rings fade between flower and star motifs.
concepts.constraint: Cymatic inspiration is visual; selected contours will approximate patterns rather than simulate physical fluid waves.

concepts.name: Octahedral Web Vault
concepts.standout: Suspended octahedra appear to float inside a web of illuminated tension lines.
concepts.scene: A vast canopy of nested octahedral frames and fine straight diagonal tension-like threads, multiple levels of crisp tetrahedral voids. Ice white, ultramarine and pinpoints of ruby, dark visible grounded perimeter pylons. A striking structural spiderweb overhead, no literal spiders, clear empty space under it.
concepts.choreography: Pulses converge along diagonals to suspended nodes, then expand along successive polyhedral shells.
concepts.constraint: This is a supported visual tensegrity study; load-bearing cables and suspended masses require engineering.

concepts.name: Nautilus Memory Library
concepts.standout: A giant spiral opens a procession of smaller chambers, each holding its own miniature light universe.
concepts.scene: A monumental upright open-wire nautilus shell pavilion, logarithmic spiral chamber ribs increasing from a pearl core to broad amber outer chambers. Each chamber holds a smaller differently patterned rosette of light; indigo shadows, black support cradle and a path around its base. Shell cross-section clearly visible.
concepts.choreography: Light seems to travel inward through chamber doorways, pauses at the core, then returns as a widening spiral.
concepts.constraint: Finite nested chambers are needed; the spiral and small inner patterns must remain readable at viewing distance.

concepts.name: Borromean Moon Garden
concepts.standout: Three entwined moon rings trade light in a visual puzzle that invites the eye to trace each path.
concepts.scene: Three enormous thick contour rings in a Borromean-inspired arrangement, visibly passing over and under one another with different tilted planes, each ring traced by several concentric thin LED lines. Moon-white, burgundy and molten gold. Low ring-fragment gardens and black grounded supports around an open circular court.
concepts.choreography: Each ring receives a slow continuous chase, then linked crossing regions gently light in succession.
concepts.constraint: Artwork is linkage-inspired; exact topology and physical separation must be checked in native geometry.

concepts.name: Fibonacci Storm Crown
concepts.standout: Hundreds of curling rays emerge from a dense seed pattern, forming a crown that seems to rotate without moving.
concepts.scene: A huge open crown of sunflower-inspired phyllotactic spiral seeds rising into curled luminous tendrils at multiple heights. Tangerine, fuchsia and pearl on black slender stems, a dark dense seed core with clearly separated points. A sculptural storm frozen in space, no flames or fog.
concepts.choreography: Two spiral families carry counter-running gradients, then crown tips light as a slow ripple.
concepts.constraint: Point ordering must preserve spiral families; height variation and stem mounting need a practical plan.

concepts.name: Sierpinski Prism Mountain
concepts.standout: A mountain of nested triangles reveals smaller mountains inside itself as the illumination changes scale.
concepts.scene: A crystalline mountain sculpture made of a finite three-level Sierpinski-tetrahedron-inspired lattice, sharply visible large tetrahedral voids and smaller triangular struts. Cyan, glacier white and sparse amber corner nodes. Low triangular foothills, grounded base and nighttime mountain-like silhouette; open structure not solid rock.
concepts.choreography: Lighting shifts from the outer tetrahedron to second- and third-level cells, producing an inward depth cascade.
concepts.constraint: Recursion is finite; inner strut density and wiring access set the practical depth limit.

concepts.name: Caustic Ribbon Grotto
concepts.standout: Curved ribs create shifting diamonds of light that look like liquid reflections suspended in air.
concepts.scene: An immersive grotto of overlapping ruled-surface light fans, each formed by many individually visible straight luminous ribs between twisting curved boundary rails. Aquamarine, warm silver and tiny amber accents; saddle canopies, dark walkway and layered diamond intersections. Elegant airy ribs, no actual water, no laser beams.
concepts.choreography: Gradients drift along separate fan layers, making their intersections appear to slide and ripple.
concepts.constraint: Caustics are a contour/brightness illusion; changing overlap is not real optical refraction.

concepts.name: Celestial Orrery Amphitheater
concepts.standout: An orbital universe surrounds a small performance stage, with cycles weaving across several inclinations.
concepts.scene: A spectacular open amphitheater around a small grounded concert platform, wrapped by nested inclined orbital light ellipses, latitude rings and tiny spherical constellation clusters on supported black stems. Midnight blue, copper gold and pearl white. Clear stage opening and crescent seating outline, no real planets or moving machinery.
concepts.choreography: Different orbit families chase at different rates; brief alignment reveals a luminous eclipse around the stage.
concepts.constraint: Orbit frames are static; performer sightlines, support spans and exact node mapping need separate design.

concepts.name: Tidal Lace Pontoon
concepts.standout: Two interwoven wave shells turn a stationary twin-hull pontoon into a luminous floating jewel.
concepts.scene: A clearly docked twin-hull pontoon with two long outlined hulls, railings and a complex double saddle-shell lace canopy. Teal-and-pearl thin ribs weave into coral diamond knots, curling wave arches along both sides and small gold speaker circles. Dark visible canopy supports, calm black water and reflected light; identifiable boat.
concepts.choreography: A slow wave travels through canopy ribs from bow to stern, while hull contours carry a delayed return current.
concepts.constraint: Docked exhibition concept; canopy stability, marine wiring and navigation clearance require engineering.

concepts.name: Anamorphic Rose Labyrinth
concepts.standout: Scattered filigree panels unite into one giant rose from the entrance, then break apart as viewers move.
concepts.scene: A dramatic entrance-view light labyrinth of many depth-separated freestanding filigree arc panels. From this exact camera position their rose-pink, pearl and wine-red fragments align into one huge symmetric rose-window mandala with a dark central circular opening. Visible side supports and pathways reveal offset layers; no flat single disk.
concepts.choreography: Successive panel depths bloom from center to edge; the full rose resolves only during a held alignment cue.
concepts.constraint: The illusion depends on a chosen viewing zone; panel offset and occlusion need actual audience-position checks.

concepts.name: Torus-Knot Dream Machine
concepts.standout: A dense torus knot turns into a slow whirlpool of light, then reveals its hidden continuous route.
concepts.scene: A monumental thick toroidal knot sculpture with five visibly looping turns and three entwined passages around a clear central aperture, nested thin parallel luminous filaments and a smaller offset inner knot. Emerald, violet and soft gold, on a black sculptural pedestal with restrained floor rings. Coherent over-under crossings, clean black negative spaces.
concepts.choreography: A single leading highlight traces the knot while opposite hue gradients circulate through outer and inner filament bundles.
concepts.constraint: A (5,3)-inspired finite knot needs exact curve sampling and clearance; visual motion uses stationary light paths.
